title: Progress Ribbon Truth: running phases stop showing clean checks

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.131 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.131 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow progress UI truth release; focused pipeline/ribbon tests plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.130 provider-run blocker report, not a completed ZIP/log audit. A fresh deployed v0.15.131 audit is required before claiming clean output or Texture 100.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.130 UX Studio provider run started but blocked before ZIP capture when Chrome became unresponsive during enrichment/progress inspection.
The visible blocker evidence showed a checked Map/progress indicator while enrichment was still running and package export remained disabled.
The shared pipeline step selector now returns neutral settled states for unfinished phase handoff and reserves clean checks for terminal ready/sync-ready states.
Blocked or caveated finish states no longer inherit clean-ready stage checks in the shared selector.
Focused pipeline and BuildRibbon regressions pin the new settled/done semantics without changing source, export, report, or grader standards.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.131 ZIP/log audit must prove the progress UI no longer shows clean checks while the build or package review is unfinished.
The separate Chrome Page Unresponsive blocker must be retested during the next provider run and fixed if it reproduces.
Fresh provider evidence must still prove overall 100/100, Texture 100/100, no hidden source/review/export caveats, and agreement across UI, ZIP, manifest, reports, digest logs, and local regrade.
Source rows must remain real, trusted, on-topic, license-safe, and concept-linked across UX and Project Management domains.
